hints.title: Grammar Parser and Tokenization
hints.text: Parsing a serialized data string into objects and arrays requires recognizing delimiters like brackets, braces, and quotes.

hints.title: Recursive Descent Character Scanner
hints.text: Maintain a character pointer index. Based on the leading character, branch into parsing an object, an array, a quoted string, a boolean, null, or a number.

hints.title: Parser Blueprint
hints.text: Let idx = 0. parseValue(): skip whitespace. If char is { parseObject; if [ parseArray; if " parseString; if t/f parseBool; if n parseNull; else parseNumber.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass recursive descent parser processes each character once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Regular expressions cannot parse arbitrarily deep nested structures without grammar support.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place character pointer avoids large token arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Writing clean modular helper functions for each JSON syntactic production.
